about_me.heading: About me
about_me.text: I'm a Front-end Engineer with over 3 years of commercial experience, specializing in modern web interfaces. Working in a small, interdisciplinary team has allowed me to handle a wide range of challenges beyond strict front-end development, including seamless integrations with CMS platforms and custom backends. I strongly believe that this cross-disciplinary background directly translates into better architectural and design decisions. I am currently looking for an environment where I can leverage my approach to build robust and creative web solutions.
